tool.name: get_knowledge
tool.when_not: The assistant must not call get_knowledge. Only use results injected by the system. get_knowledge is system-triggered, typically after get_memory, and may also run on user-simulated calls.
tool.desc: System-side retrieval tool. It decides what to inject and deduplicates content: entries already present in context may be skipped. A skipped injection is not a failure and should not be retried. Default type is "lorebook"; type "memory" is used for memory bodies.
